name: Tanglin Trust School
summary: British curriculum staple in Portsdown with a long expat family reputation.
body: Tanglin Trust delivers an English National Curriculum pathway toward IGCSEs and A-Levels / IB options depending on pathway year. Location near Portsdown / one-north makes it a Holland V and west-central favourite. Admissions are structured and competitive in infant and junior years.
waitlistNotes: Register as early as policy allows; year-group demand varies.
